bio.text: The Cult supplies Ravnica with menial labor and entertainment while keeping its demon quiescent, and its slumbering lord rests in a lava pit beneath Rix Maadi.

bio.text: At the Decamillennial, Izolda used dragon fluid and Myc's blood to rouse Rakdos, whose mind became linked with Myc's when Jarad disrupted the ritual, and she took control by killing Jarad.

bio.text: Rakdos was badly damaged in battle with Project Kraj, the Boros angel Feather dumped his body back into the lava pit, and Izolda's cultists devoured her.

bio.text: In later years the guild's thugs and raiders became tangled in Ravnican conflicts, including the Rakdos-led massacre of Cecilee's vernadi that led the Gruul to declare war on the Rakdos.

bio.text: During the War of the Spark Rakdos at first refused to help because Hekara had been killed, then carried Gideon toward Bolas and was knocked from the air.

bio.text: Afterward the Cult fought in Ravnica's defense during the New Phyrexian invasion, and Judith plotted unsuccessfully to overthrow Rakdos and framed him for the Karlov Manor murders until his name was cleared.

bio.text: Rakdos then left Ravnica for Thunder Junction, where he joined Oko's crew for the Maag Taranau heist, knocked Ral aside, defeated Akul and carried the crew out of the collapsing vault.

timeline.summary: Izolda sacrifices Jarad in a ritual to arouse Rakdos, but he survives by becoming a zombie/lich and keeps leadership.
timeline.quote: He was later sacrificed by Izolda ( Lyzolda, the Blood Witch ) as part of a ritual to arouse Rakdos , the parun of the Cult of Rakdos .

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The remaining three nephilim reach the center of Ravnica City, where Rakdos kills one and the last two die in mana explosions.
timeline.quote: Rakdos killed one of them, and the last two were killed by mana explosions.

citation.text: "Nephilim", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The guilds return to ascendance; most get new guildmasters except the Izzet, Orzhov and Rakdos.
timeline.quote: the guilds returned and became ascendant

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists hang a rusalka, whose ghost keeps vigil at the Tree of Weeping.
timeline.quote: Rakdos cultists hanged her for sport in the township square.

citation.text: Martyred Rusalka (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakdos relishes entertainment with his dinner.
timeline.quote: I like a little entertainment with my dinner.

citation.text: Cackling Flames (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakdos calls on his servants to rage, renewing ancient power in blood.
timeline.quote: Rage, my servants. Our ancient power is renewed in blood.

citation.text: Psychotic Fury (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belko warns of the Demon's work in a rain of gore.
timeline.quote: This is the Demon's work, and only ill can come of it.

citation.text: Rain of Gore (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakdos adds the touch of having spikes rip through the skin from beneath.
timeline.quote: Having the spikes rip through the skin from beneath was a touch added by Rakdos himself.

citation.text: Riot Spikes (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Decamillennial, Izolda uses dragon spinal fluid and the blood of Jarad and Myc to rouse Rakdos, who wreaks havoc until absorbed by Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Rakdos awakened and wreaked havoc in the streets of Ravnica until the demon crossed the path of Project Kraj .

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Boros angel Feather throws the comatose Rakdos back into his lava pit.
timeline.quote: the comatose Rakdos was thrown back into his lava pit, Rix Maadi, by the Boros angel Feather

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sensing weakness after Rakdos's defeat, Izolda's followers devour her alive.
timeline.quote: Izolda's followers summarily devoured her alive.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lyzolda uses Myc's blood to raise Rakdos but Jarad's intervention disrupts the ritual and links Myc's mind to the demon.
timeline.quote: The demon is awakened but the intervention of Jarad disrupts the ritual and gives Myc a mind link with the demon god instead.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 11". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Myc and Rakdos rampage into the main city and attack Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: They both head into the main city, destroying everything in their path, killing a Nephilim, and beginning an attack against Vitu-Ghazi .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 12". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lyzolda kills Jarad and uses his blood to complete the ritual and take control of Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Jarad catches up with Lyzolda, who kills him and uses his blood to complete the ritual and take control of Rakdos.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 16". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kraj absorbs Rakdos and goes still; Lyzolda collapses from the backlash and is eaten alive by her cultists.
timeline.quote: Lyzolda suffers the backlash from Rakdos' wounds, collapses, and is eaten alive by the other cultists.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 17". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda raises Rakdos from his pit with Myc Zunich's blood; Myc briefly controls him before Izolda takes control.
timeline.quote: Izolda was able to finish the ritual and took control over Rakdos herself.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos kills Momir Vig, Kraj falls, Rakdos is badly damaged and Izolda is torn apart by her cultists; Rakdos falls into a coma.
timeline.quote: However, Vig was killed by Agrus Kos and Kraj fell later, during the fight.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather dumps Rakdos' body back into his lava pit.
timeline.quote: Later, the new Boros guildmaster Feather dumped Rakdos' body back into his lava pit

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda's Rakdos cultists use Myc's blood to awaken Rakdos; his parents interrupt, Myc bonds with the demon, and Rakdos rampages across Ravnica City.
timeline.quote: allowing the demon to rampage across Ravnica City.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The remaining nephilim are stopped by Fonn's Ledev team and Rakdos; Rakdos and Kraj fight to a draw and both are incapacitated; Rakdos returns to his lava pit and Svogthir and Momir Vig are killed.
timeline.quote: both titans ended up incapacitated.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos stirred from slumber and everyone else's nightmare began.
timeline.quote: When Lord Rakdos stirred from his slumber, everyone else's nightmare began.

citation.text: Rakdos's Return (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cryptwitch Merree vanished after a spat with Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Cryptwitch Merree vanished after a spat with Rakdos

citation.text: Cryptborn Horror (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Joining the Worldsoul took years, severed by the snap of Rakdos's fingers.
timeline.quote: Severing that connection took the snap of Rakdos's fingers.

citation.text: Traitorous Instinct (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace erases his memory of the Izzet's secrets as Emmara watches helpless, and the Rakdos come for them.
timeline.quote: she was left helpless as she watched him destroy his knowledge

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists waylay Fonn's training group; Jarad and Fonn accidentally bind Myc's mind to the demon.
timeline.quote: accidentally binding Myc's mind with the demon 's.

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Judith, jealous of Rakdos's adoration, assembles an entourage who echo her complaints about the guildmaster.
timeline.quote: She believed that the guild needed new leadership

citation.text: "Judith", section "Jealous of Rakdos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad Vod Savo rises as a lich after sacrificing himself to save his son from the demon Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Jarad learned the ways of necromancy and was able to rise as a lich after sacrificing himself to save his son from the demon Rakdos.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2", section "Jarad Vod Savo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kuma smells blood and carries Ruzi through the shattered gate into the settlement, surprising Massacre Girl and her men.
timeline.quote: The two surprised Massacre Girl and her men as they searched the bodies for anything valuable.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi gutted the first cultist to attack and is surrounded, weakened by the fear that Cecilee is among the dead.
timeline.quote: Cecilee's body would be among the dead, and that knowledge made Ruzi weak.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl refuses to say who hired her, taunts Ruzi, and leaves with her cultists, throwing confetti.
timeline.quote: Tossing it up into the air, she did a twisted bow and sashayed for the gate.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos.
timeline.quote: "They killed your infant!" Ruzi said.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Nikya, convinced by the bloodwriting her scouts saw, declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
timeline.quote: They will be slaughtered in the streets where they live.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: The Rakdos guild parades through the streets to open the Slaughter Games while Maritta bars her door and shelters her children.
timeline.quote: Maritta slammed the door and slammed down the crossbar.

citation.text: "Slaughter Games". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Darux's ring enters the festival grounds and sets up camp as night falls.
timeline.quote: Darux led his ring to the area he had chosen for their camp

citation.text: "Slaughter Games". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Durri tells Kal that the Selesnyan healer's camp was massacred, reportedly by the Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Ogreth said it was the Rakdos.

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nikya entangles a Rakdos ogre in vines as the Zhur-Taa fight the Rakdos swarm.
timeline.quote: A huge wall of vines entangled a massive Rakdos ogre

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A Rakdos bloodwitch summons batlike demons from the earth, and the tide turns against the Gruul.
timeline.quote: massive, wet claws erupted from the earth

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A Rakdos flailer hooks Kal and drags him across the ground.
timeline.quote: A flailer had hooked him.

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kal channels what he learned from the Izzet into a fire-and-lightning spell that incinerates the flailer, the demons and the remaining Rakdos.
timeline.quote: A blast of fire incinerated the grinning flailer.

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Rakdos unleashed hellraiser goblins against Boros interference.
timeline.quote: Tired of Boros interference, the Rakdos unleashed hellraiser goblins

citation.text: Wojek Halberdiers (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia says she has heard Gideon saved a Boros brigade from a Rakdos ambush.
timeline.quote: I have word that you saved an entire brigade of my Boros from a Rakdos ambush that would have killed every last one of them.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia shows Gideon the contested Ninth on her war table and explains how the guilds fight over it.
timeline.quote: The Rakdos and Gruul tug and tear it apart like a dromad's corpse

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia recounts that after the Guildpact broke the Azorius abandoned the Ninth and it was largely lost, under a disgraced earlier Boros leader.
timeline.quote: in the aftermath, the Azorius had to abandon the Ninth so they could rebuild New Prahv.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jek and Vinni hide in the walls of an apartment in the Ninth District, hunted by Rakdos thrill-killers over a Dimir key.
timeline.quote: Now, he and his sister, Vinni, crouched within the walls of the small apartment

citation.text: "The One Hundred Steps". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jek hands Vinni his Azorius-etched dagger and shackles a spike jester with a spell, then they break out and fight their way into the street.
timeline.quote: Crackling blue energy flared out and shackled the spike jester with glowing Azorius glyphs.

citation.text: "The One Hundred Steps". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tajic arrives pursued by the Rakdos, surviving a demonic spell.
timeline.quote: A thunderclap of demonic magic hit Tajic like a cannonball and enveloped him in a cloud of fire and sulfur.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Firefist opens its line and the Rakdos pour into the square, where Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other while the Boros contain them.
timeline.quote: Rakdos and Gruul slaughtered each other in the center of the square

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Dack steals a dagger from the Cult of Rakdos and learns it was held by Sifa Grent, who murdered Drakeston.
timeline.quote: he learned who was responsible for the deaths of everyone he had known. Her name was Sifa Grent .

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cult of Rakdos led by Massacre Girl slaughters Cecilee's followers and kills Cecilee; Zi survives and is rescued by Ruzi.
timeline.quote: Cecilee herself was killed, unaware that her adopted son Zi had survived

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ruzi breaks from the Conclave, turns to the Gruul, and Nikya declares a blood feud against the Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Ruzi officially broke from the Conclave and turned to the Gruul

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aurelia splits the legion into four theatres to deal with threats to public order.
timeline.quote: Aurelia has split leadership of the bulk of the legion into four

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the War of the Spark, Rakdos refuses to cooperate because Hekara was killed.
timeline.quote: Rakdos initially was not cooperating at all with the anti-Bolas efforts because Hekara , his emissary, was killed.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos serves as Gideon's Unlikely Aid against Bolas and is knocked out of the air.
timeline.quote: He was knocked out of the air by Bolas when Gideon was riding him.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos after the massacre of Cecilee's vernadi, over the perceived killing of Zi.
timeline.quote: Nikya declared war on the Rakdos, swearing revenge over the perceived killing of the Gruul infant Zi.

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Janik discovers Kal, but a battle with Rakdos breaks out and they join it.
timeline.quote: Kal was discovered by a warrior named Janik

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Rakdos flailer ogre wounds Kal, and he channels Izzet-style magic from rage and desperation.
timeline.quote: a Rakdos flailer ogre caught Kal's leg and sent him sprawling to the ground

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kal unleashes a blast of fire that destroys the Rakdos and demons and passes out.
timeline.quote: With a blast of fire, Kal incinerated the grinning flailer.

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Implicit Maze, a battle erupts in Rix Maadi between Rakdos and Selesnya, wounding Exava and Emmara.
timeline.quote: a battle broke out between the local Rakdos and Selesnya representatives

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heroes seek Rakdos's aid during the War of the Spark but Rakdos refuses.
timeline.quote: Although Rakdos himself refused to aid

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Rix Maadi, Tomik brings Hekara's corpse, the cultists resurrect her as a blood witch, and she defeats Exava and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon's flesh.
timeline.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon.
timeline.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hekara is revived as a bloodwitch and goes to help Kaya's group; Rakdos does not stop her.
timeline.quote: Hekara's corpse was brought back by Tomik and she was revived as a bloodwitch.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos attacks Nicol Bolas with Gideon Jura riding him and is knocked from the air.
timeline.quote: He was knocked out of the air by Bolas when Gideon was riding him.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tomik reunites with Ral and Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch to lead the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos brings Gideon within striking distance but is knocked out, and Gideon's Blackblade shatters against Bolas, who had enchanted it.
timeline.quote: Bolas reveals he enchanted the Blackblade thousands of years ago, preventing it from being able to harm an elder dragon again.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos's voice booms through the cavern demanding to know where his emissary is.
timeline.quote: WHERE IS OUR EMISSARY?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rakdos refuses Niv-Mizzet's plan and Exava tells the group to leave.
timeline.quote: WE'LL HAVE NONE OF IT!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rakdos appears as a giant flaming demon with Gideon riding his head, charging Bolas.
timeline.quote: And then I spotted Mister Jura, riding atop the demon's head.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Bolas blasts Rakdos back, but Gideon leaps over and strikes; Blackblade shatters against Bolas's brow.
timeline.quote: Blackblade shattered against Nicol Bolas's invincible brow.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
